title: Invoice Status offers exactly four options; All Statuses is the default
refs: SV-8622 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17 Story 4 S4-R1; S4-R2; S4-R3; S4-R5 — S4-R2 CLOSES the list itself ("exactly four options"); so the closed list IS the requirement)
preconds: 1. You are on the report with no remembered settings.
steps:
1. Find the "Invoice Status" dropdown in the toolbar and read its default value.
  2. Open it and read the options.
  3. Change the selection and watch the table.
expected:
1. An "Invoice Status" dropdown is visible in the toolbar.
  2. It offers exactly four options: "All Statuses," "Unpaid," "Partially Paid," "Paid."
  3. "All Statuses" is the default on first load.
  4. Changing the selection re-fetches and re-renders the report.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Representative report specification version 22 (S4-R1, S4-R2, S4-R3, S4-R5), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
